verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a networking/VPN connectivity platform, not an agent that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The MCP-adjacent evidence does not show Tailscale itself plugging in MCP servers to use their tools. tsidp only secures MCP servers with OIDC, the agent skill serves coding agents, and the Aperture gateway proxies LLM requests.
